The notes Button flips notesExpanded, writes the new state, and has one callback site using current data.requestID and open/closed. The false branch removes notesBody. Closing is source-only; this route never activates it.

Both choose handlers guard submitted, same selection and unavailable delegate; choosing self writes self and clears acknowledgment, with one collector callback using current requestID. Conditional acknowledgment disappears and validity becomes true. This reverse selection is not dispatched in the captured route.

The native binding/handler accepts a changed false value only for an available, unsent delegate, stores false and emits one ack callback containing current requestID and false. Delegate validity then becomes false. No runtime true-to-false transition is inferred.

Self is a valid collector. Submit guards unsent validity, records submitted and invokes one submit callback with current requestID and self event value. The submitted flag selects sent copy and disables primary/choices/ack. This is source logic only; actual self submission was not dispatched.
Both actual choice action paths return on same collector before state write or onEvent. The already-selected activation is unexecuted; this is solely a source guard judgment.

Choices have native disabled state and submitted/availability/same-choice guards; acknowledgment has enabled state and matching guards; submit has native enabled state plus unsent/current-valid guard. Rejected paths have no business onEvent call. Disabled controls were not activated in the runtime route.

The approved file exposes public data properties and the complete named initializer, public View and init(data:onEvent:), and declares iOS 14 availability. Its native SwiftUI APIs include ScaledMetric, onChange and SwitchToggleStyle, available at that floor. This is preliminary source-only API review; the sealed module/client typecheck is separate, with no iOS14 rendering claim.
